title: Provisions for the Voyage

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Ahoy, shipmate! This week the ship sails along the coast to the fishing villages, and you're coming!

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: First, the provisions. Here's my list. Read it, and load just what it says into the hold.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Read the list. Put the right things in the hold, then press Done.

older.prompt: Read the list: no pictures this time. Put the right things in the hold, then press Done.

feedback.all_good: Shipshape! We won't go hungry at sea.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: The hold's full. A sailor who packs carefully sleeps soundly. We sail with the morning tide!

journal_line: I loaded provisions into Captain Mara's ship for a summer voyage.
